rules.title: New listening socket compared with baseline
rules.description: A TCP/UDP listener exists that was not listening in the baseline evidence.
rules.why: {proto} port {local_port} (process: {process}) was not listening in the baseline.
false_positives: New legitimate software or service restarts.
next_steps: Identify the owning process, its path and signer.

rules.title: Listener on analyst-defined port of interest
rules.description: A socket listens on a port from the configurable list (defaults are well-known tooling ports).
false_positives: Any application may legitimately use these port numbers.
next_steps: Inspect the owning process, path and signature.

rules.title: Established connection owned by a process in a user-writable location
rules.description: An outbound connection is owned by a process whose executable lives in a user-writable directory. The remote address is not judged.
false_positives: Portable apps, installers and updaters run from these directories.
next_steps: Check the remote address against IOC lists; review the process (see process findings).
